# Feature Request

**Before submitting**, please check the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/w9aE98gKDs) to see if this has already been requested.

---

## Summary

A short, one-line description of the feature.

## Description

A clear and concise explanation of what you want added or changed, and why it would be useful.

## Proposed API

If you have an idea of what the method signature should look like, include it here:

```java
// Example:
ClassName.methodName(paramType param);
```

## Use Case

Describe a real scenario where this feature would be used. The more concrete, the better.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you found any workarounds or alternatives? Why are they not sufficient?

## Additional Notes

Any other context, links, or references that might be helpful (e.g. a Wikipedia article, a similar method in another library).

---

**To submit this request**, post it in [#bugs-suggestions-and-feedback](https://discord.com/channels/1296889247176982528/1298419569135980564) on the Discord server.
